units.source_text: 你还记得吧，你常常跟我讨论一些现代思想的问题，

en.t: You remember, don't you, how you often discussed questions of modern thought with me,

units.source_text: 你也很清楚我的态度吧。

en.t: and you know very well what my attitude was.

units.source_text: 虽说我没有轻视过你的见解，但也绝对说不上敬佩。

en.t: Although I never looked down on your opinions, I certainly could not say that I admired them.

units.source_text: 你的思想没有任何底蕴，而且你太年轻，不可能有什么阅历。

en.t: Your ideas had no depth behind them, and you were too young to have gained any real experience.

units.source_text: 我常常笑你，你时常流露出不满足的神色。

en.t: I often laughed at you, and you would frequently show a look of dissatisfaction.

units.source_text: 最终，你逼迫我把我的过去展示给你，犹如展开一幅画卷一般。

en.t: In the end, you pressed me to lay out my past before you, as if unrolling a picture scroll.

units.source_text: 直到那时，我才从心底里开始尊敬你。

en.t: Only then did I begin to respect you from the bottom of my heart.

units.source_text: 因为我看到了你不顾一切地要从我的体内捕捉某种活生生的东西的决心，

en.t: For I saw your determination to seize, at any cost, some living thing from within me,

units.source_text: 你要剖开我的心脏，吮吸那温乎乎的流动着的血。

en.t: to cut open my heart and suck the warm blood flowing there.

units.source_text: 那时我还活着，还不愿意死，所以，就约定了以后告诉你，而拒绝了你的要求。

en.t: At that time I was still alive and did not want to die, so I promised to tell you later and rejected your demand.

units.source_text: 现在，我要剖开自己的心脏，将鲜血洒到你的脸上，

en.t: Now I am going to cut open my own heart and splash its fresh blood onto your face,

units.source_text: 倘若在我的心脏停止跳动的时候，能在你胸中孕育新的生命，我就心满意足了。

en.t: and if, when my heart stops beating, a new life can be nurtured within your breast, I will be fully satisfied.
